_meta.description: Published accuracy baselines for each FakeSpotter backend. Update after each corpus refresh. A backend is flagged DEGRADED if its current accuracy falls more than DEGRADATION_THRESHOLD points below its baseline.

hf_audio_ensemble.caveats: Trained on ASVspoof 2021; post-2024 TTS systems not in training data

hf_music.caveats: Lower on vocal-heavy tracks; best on instrumentals

hf_text_ensemble.source: Estimated from Hello-SimpleAI/chatgpt-detector-roberta published benchmarks (pre-2024 data); real-world accuracy lower on newer LLMs
hf_text_ensemble.caveats: Known degradation on post-GPT-3.5 models. Baseline intentionally conservative.
